title: Needle entry on the patient
view: The face from the front, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left; a gloved thumb from below pulls the lower lip down.
teachingPoint: Retract the lower lip, enter the mucobuccal fold below the premolars, and aim down toward the mental foramen on the pupil line; stop short.
claims: Front view, patient's right on the image left (house laterality).
Gloved thumb retracting the lower lip to expose the mucobuccal fold (record).
Needle into the fold below the first/second premolar, directed inferiorly toward the foramen (record).
Dashed ring: the mental foramen, below the premolars toward the pupil line (record).

geometry.why: the fold is below the premolars
the thumb leaves the target visible
